source: Combat Universe Chronicle v0.11.3 portrait expansion delta

rules.gender: ATP uses male pools; WTA uses female pools.
rules.identity: Face, skin tone, hair and appearance are baked into finished portrait assets.
rules.runtime: No skin recoloring and no facial-component overlays.
rules.selection: Country weights appearance family; social personality biases compatible elite portraits; player id makes assignment deterministic.
rules.fame: Fame changes presentation prominence only so a player's face never changes during a save.
